card.name: Inside drug names and forms
card.fires_on: Partway through multiword drug names, salt names and dosage-form names in label text, such as the sodium after liothyronine or the -release after extended. Also some word endings inside long drug or medical terms.

modes.label: Salt or form after drug name
modes.description: Salt or release-form word right after a drug name, before the product type such as tablets or capsules.
modes.example: Carefully monitor glycemic control, especially when liothyronine<< sodium>> tablets are started, changed, or discontinued

modes.label: Inside long drug terms
modes.description: A later piece of a long drug or enzyme name, where the word is not yet finished or has just finished.
